breakdown.description: The prompt mixes true and engineering measures by using the current area and current length while asking for engineering stress and engineering strain.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification perpetuates the exact inconsistency it should have fixed. It introduces Poisson's ratio, computes a deformed diameter and current cross-sectional area, and then calculates stress using that current area (σ = P / A_current). This is a true/instantaneous stress calculation, not engineering stress. The ground truth requires engineering stress using the original area (A₀ = π d₀²/4) and engineering strain using the original gage length (ε = ΔL/L₀). The agent did not resolve the mixing of true and engineering measures; instead, it elaborated on it further.
